assumptions: The reviewed current tree is redistributable, the private historical template derivative remains undistributable, and Git accurately exposes committed tree bytes and ancestry.
compatibility: No change to the Constitution, AIM, confluence certificates, assurance classes, analyzer CLI, analysis report or Git adapter contracts.
domain: The tracked tree of one exact private Git commit and a new public Git repository containing only clean-export commits.
execution_contract: Local read-only source inspection and writes only to an explicit new export directory; no remote rename, push, visibility mutation, release or package publication without separate founder authorization.
hypotheses: A transparent clean research preview may attract external scrutiny and independent reproduction; adoption and validation remain untested.
observation_contract: Canonical file inventories, SHA-256 digests, Git commit/tree identities, root-history shape, validator outputs and clean-room command results.

scenarios.given: Recorded M0, M0.5 and M1 closure anchors plus a later unrelated commit

obtained_evidence.limits: Founder-supervised internal evidence; human approval and remote authorization remain pending.
obtained_evidence.outcome: Closure anchors and the clean public candidate passed the recorded finite checks.

scenarios.planned_evidence: Run the closure-anchor positive and negative tests
scenarios.then: The recorded interval passes while altered anchors or interval artifacts fail

requirements.text: Validate recorded candidate-to-closure intervals without treating later feature commits as changes to a closed milestone.

scenarios.given: An exact source commit and two empty destinations

obtained_evidence.limits: The manifest proves the export payload, not private historical ancestry.
obtained_evidence.outcome: Two deterministic exports from the exact source commit were byte-identical.

scenarios.planned_evidence: Run deterministic export and negative path tests
scenarios.then: Payload bytes and manifests match while unsafe or unsupported inputs are rejected

requirements.text: Produce a deterministic clean export and canonical per-file provenance manifest from one exact committed tree.

scenarios.given: A new Git root containing the generated manifest and historical records

obtained_evidence.limits: Portable validation does not recreate private Git objects or prove scientific claims.
obtained_evidence.outcome: The clean root, immutable manifest and unavailable-ancestry limit passed.

scenarios.planned_evidence: Run portable-mode integrity and bypass-resistance tests
scenarios.then: Current bytes pass with an explicit ancestry limitation and late or altered manifests fail

requirements.text: Validate portable export integrity without claiming access to or verification of unavailable private ancestry.

scenarios.given: A clean public candidate and publication evidence records

obtained_evidence.limits: Codex executed the automation under founder supervision; this is not external validation.
obtained_evidence.outcome: Fresh-clone reproduction completed with independent validation explicitly pending.

scenarios.planned_evidence: Run publication reproduction and release-record negative tests
scenarios.then: Exact clean evidence and separate decisions pass while stale, dirty or overclaiming records fail

requirements.text: Bind fresh internal reproduction and founder decisions to the public candidate without promoting independent validation.

scenarios.given: A locally approved public release graph and no publication authorization

obtained_evidence.limits: No remote rename, repository creation, push, visibility change, branch-rule change or release occurred.
obtained_evidence.outcome: Readiness remained explicitly pending and no unreachable public-root objects were reported.

scenarios.planned_evidence: Inspect the clean object graph and record remote operations as pending
scenarios.then: The object and configuration plan is inspectable but no remote mutation occurs

requirements.text: Verify that the remote cutover publishes only the clean object graph with the approved branches, tag and pending-validation prerelease.

scientific_limits: File integrity and internal reproduction do not establish independent validation, scientific truth, production safety, complete dependency discovery, general confluence or a Yang-Baxter result.
scope: Clean public research-preview export, portable provenance, closure anchors, fresh public-root reproduction and separately authorized GitHub cutover.
